howTo.title: LeadWing client tracker
howTo.intro: Your buyers and sellers in one file, with a colour on every client who needs a call.

steps.rows: One row per client: buyers on the {buyers} sheet, sellers on the {sellers} sheet. A seller with two properties takes two rows.
steps.lists: In {stage}, {priority}, {active} and the other columns listed below, use the words shown there, so LeadWing reads them as they are.
steps.lastContact: Each time you speak to a client, type the date in {column}, year first: 2026-09-29.
steps.nextFollowUp: In {column}, put the day you should get back to them.
steps.colours: A row turns amber when its {column} is today or earlier, and grey once {days} days have gone by without contact.
steps.columns: Add columns of your own if you need them: LeadWing brings them in as notes.

howTo.wordsTypes: {buyers} (one or more, separated by commas) and {sellers}: {words}
howTo.import: Move it into LeadWing: sign in at leadwing.app, open {buyersPage}, choose “{action}” and pick the {buyersSheet} sheet. Do the same in {sellersPage} with the {sellersSheet} sheet.
